verdict.score_rationale: The board sits between the flat 5 anchor and the unfinished 6 anchor: it is readable and regionally organized, but pervasive generic gray boxes, weak registry vocabulary, and oversized empty bands prevent it from feeling pin-up finished.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The four numbered regions establish a clear frame, but large unexplained vertical gaps and the sparsely occupied lower section leave substantial dead space.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Pastel region fills and colored routes provide grouping, yet nearly every operational object is rendered as the same gray box rather than carrying registry-specific colors.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: Routes are generally clean, labeled, and free of visible crosshair waypoints or orphan badges, though several long feedback wires make the routing apparatus visually prominent.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Local rows and box sizes align consistently, but repeated identical panels flatten hierarchy, decision points remain ordinary rectangles, and uneven regional density weakens the overall rhythm.
